wholePhysicalScope: Official monument polygon 895 and the named OSM valve-house rectangle agree to local surveying tolerance. The surveyed shore and separate dam scene set the base.
lodDetails: All detail levels retain the historically documented exterior and setting. Near levels refine coping, supported projections, openings and stone details.
limitations: The model follows the dual mapped footprint. Roof height, the position and number of individual openings and the catwalk dimensions are estimates.
The original 5 m terrain and the native road axis constrain the adjacent crest. The pier masonry and water-side foundation level are approximate.
